blockedLegalInput.whyThePrecedentsDoNotReachIt: Both worked precedents pass this test rather than defeat it. Georgia has no hardStop at all, only a conditional localFormOverride. Massachusetts is the only one of the three whose governing record names the composed pleading and refuses it. Copying the siblings faithfully means checking that clause, and here it holds.
